description: PAID $0.05 USDC. For a store domain, brand or category: product and variant counts, in-stock %, avg/median/min/max price, share on sale, top product types and brands, deepest live discounts, newest products, 7-day change counts. Returns JSON counts, in-stock percent, price stats, brands, deepest discounts, newest products, and 7-day change counts for the slice.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

brand.description: Optional brand name. Format: the brand string. Example: Allbirds. Omit when filtering by domain or category instead.

category.description: Optional category. Format: one of the values already in the tool text: apparel, beauty, electronics, supplements, home, outdoor, jewelry, pets, toys. Example: beauty.

domain.description: Optional store domain. Format: a hostname. Example: allbirds.com. Provide a domain, a brand, or a category.
